name: Kiwi - Teams replies to requester
importBlocker: A genuine import package requires an exported Power Platform solution with environment-specific connection references, Team ID, Channel ID, and provisioned confirmation columns. Those resources were not available, so no ZIP contract is fabricated.

connections.purpose: Read tickets, check effective permissions, deduplicate and persist exchange state
Page through replies to existing Kiwi root messages
Resolve the authenticated human Teams author to UPN and claims

EuropaTickets.purpose: Full public reply; never truncate to the legacy 255-character field
Actual validated Teams author; native rule sends this agent a confirmation copy
Correlates the staged reply with TicketExchanges
New GUID for every dispatch; native rule triggers only when this changes
Explicit handshake; never call a native-rule attempt delivered

nativeRule.trigger: RequesterReplyDispatchToken changes and RequesterReplyState equals ReadyForNativeRule
nativeRule.confirmation: The actual agent must set RequesterReplyState to AgentConfirmed after checking the native-rule copy. The poller then marks the matching exchange AgentConfirmed. Neither ReadyForNativeRule nor an email rule invocation is labelled delivered.
nativeRule.staleRecipientProtection: Every dispatch atomically overwrites requester, actual agent, text, source message ID, timestamp and a new token. A ticket with an unresolved ReadyForNativeRule dispatch rejects later public replies until confirmed, cancelled or failed.

checks: teamId and channelId are not placeholders
activationCutoffUtc parses as UTC and is not in the future
all required columns exist with the specified types
pipeline.onFailure: Terminate Failed with the missing configuration; process no messages

pipeline.filter: TeamsThreadId ne null and TeamsThreadId ne ''

pagination.onThresholdReached: Terminate Failed; do not advance any watermark

pipeline.logic: For tickets whose RequesterReplyState is AgentConfirmed, update only the TicketExchanges item whose SourceMessageId equals RequesterReplySourceMessageId from AwaitingNativeRule to AgentConfirmed. Never use latest-item or requester-only matching.

pagination.onThresholdReached: Record a flow-level failure and terminate; silently dropping later pages is forbidden

checks: reply ID differs from the root TeamsThreadId

steps.onFailure: Persist FailedTerminal only when SourceMessageId can be claimed; otherwise terminate visibly

steps.implementation: Use built-in expressions only: XML-wrap the Teams HTML after escaping ampersands, normalising non-breaking spaces and self-closing br/hr tags, then xpath string(.), trim and normalise CRLF. Run in its own scope.
steps.onFailure: Persist FailedRetryable with conversion error; never guess or forward raw HTML

steps.publicWhen: Plain text equals '@user' followed by non-empty text, or starts with literal case-sensitive '@user ' / '@user\n' / '@user\r\n'
steps.strip: Remove exactly the first five characters '@user', then trim; do not remove arbitrary mentions elsewhere
steps.onFalse: Persist once as Visibility=Internal, DeliveryState=IgnoredInternal; do not stage requester fields

checks: Demandeur0 exists on the current ticket
no unresolved ReadyForNativeRule dispatch exists on this ticket
steps.onFailure: Persist FailedRetryable or FailedTerminal with an explicit error; never reuse a previous requester

steps.onFalse: Persist FailedTerminal='Teams author lacks effective EditListItems'; do not stage or notify

rules: no existing item means create Processing with AttemptCount=1
Processing with an unexpired lease means skip
expired Processing or due FailedRetryable means increment AttemptCount and reacquire
AgentConfirmed, AwaitingNativeRule, IgnoredInternal or FailedTerminal means skip
AttemptCount greater than maxAttempts becomes FailedTerminal

steps.precondition: Re-read the ticket immediately before patch; Demandeur0 and TeamsThreadId must still match the validated values and no unresolved dispatch may exist

steps.match: exact leased item ID and SourceMessageId

fields.Title: Public Teams reply pending native rule

retryable: Teams throttling or transient connector failure
temporary SharePoint or Office 365 Users failure
ticket has another unresolved public dispatch
terminal: author is not an authenticated enabled human
reply text is empty after @user stripping
failurePolicy.recovery: A retry scope updates the existing exchange by exact item ID. It never creates a second SourceMessageId, never changes Visibility from Internal to Public, and never sets Delivered. Operators can correct data and set FailedRetryable with a future NextAttemptAt or cancel explicitly.

invariants: Only a reply beginning with literal case-sensitive @user after HTML-to-text conversion can become Public
The Teams author is an enabled human and is not the flow identity
The Teams author has current effective EditListItems permission on the Kiwi site
No public reply is processed before activationCutoffUtc
Every Teams reply page and every SharePoint query uses pagination with a visible threshold failure
SourceMessageId is the unique durable dedupe key
Trigger and per-ticket/per-reply loops have concurrency 1
No message longer than 255 characters is written to R_x00e9_ponseaudemandeur; full text uses RequesterReplyText
Native rule invocation and native Author/Editor notifications are never treated as proof of delivery
No stale requester or agent value may be reused from an earlier dispatch
